question: The mean and median of the distribution is 12 and 15. Then the mode equals to:
solution:
The correct answer is **21. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Mode: **

 
• The mode is the measure of central tendency that identifies the category or score that occurs the most frequently within the distribution of data.
 
• In other words, mode represents the data that occurs the highest number of times. 

**Types of Mode: **

Four types of mode are seen. These are - 

 
• **Unimodal:** The data has one mode. For example, the Mode of data set {14, 15, 16, 17, 20, 15, 31, 42, 15, 69, 15, 18, 15, 19} is 15 as there is only one value repeating itself. Hence, it is a unimodal data set.
